dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This reminds me of a story that a retainer once told me several years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: There was a wandering samurai who, while crossing the forest at night, noticed that the familiar scenery was beginning to change right in front of him.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The man stopped and realized that it was as if he was in another world. Strange creatures that didn't appear to be human were all staring at him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whaa! That's super scary! Paimon doesn't even dare look at all these trees after hearing that story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Will we really be okay...? If anything weird jumps out at us, teach it a lesson, {NICKNAME}!
